parts.note: One set-equality invariant, with necessary listing semantics. Validation/review covers pre-existing drift independently of authoring operations; exact listings waive only this part's drift finding.

One provenance obligation for registry entries. Prose and marker edits are source-supported exclusions. Command evidence illustrates the supplied regeneration workflow, while then remains expressed in terms of regeneration.
One decision-locality obligation. Split, duplicated, and registry-held decision content are applications of the source requirement. Both authoring and existing-corpus review are covered.

audit.summary: All 49 segments survive. The linked parts retain exact listing, generated provenance, decision atomicity, resolver ownership, and strict enforcement. No new waiver, material strengthening, or application-specific overfitting was found; paths and commands originate in the source.

parts.risk: The bidirectional set-equality obligation and empty-set exception are clear. A weak agent must read the avoid and unless items together to distinguish unmarked prose containing ADR ids from surrounding prose that is not compared; the full fallback listing algorithm is otherwise confined to verifier_detail.

The activation and prohibition on hand-typed entries are explicit, with the generator workflow and allowed prose/marker edits clearly distinguished. Provenance still requires session or plan evidence rather than inspection of the final listing alone.

The required decision locality, ADR attributes, and prohibition on splitting, duplicating, or placing decision content in the registry are explicit. Deciding whether two ADRs represent distinct decisions remains a content judgment, not an ambiguity in the rule.

review.summary: Independent review found no dropped source segment and no net loss or net gain. All non-PRESERVED audit markings are benign compressions of headings or term labels, and shared:policy.strict-disposition retains strict enforcement. The three parts have distinct obligations and activations; their requires edges preserve the source's jointly mandatory listing, regeneration, and decision-atomicity requirements. The original resolver dependency is sensibly remapped to every part, resolver ownership remains explicit, and the parent alias resolves to all three parts.
